_about: Settings for this city's discovery places layer (engine/discover/build.py), docs/chicago/data/discover.geojson: places the City of Chicago describes in its own open data, plus hand-checked viewpoints, for Along the way and the app. No businesses on the website. Keys as Toronto's discover.json (_about there), plus: label = a fixed first part of the line under the name; minText = texts shorter than this are left out (the place stays); textSkip = a regex: a text that matches is left out (notes to the registry rather than about the mural). Sources (City of Chicago Data Portal, its Terms of Use; no endorsement implied): the Mural Registry (DCASE; the registrant's own description, quoted word for word with credit), Individual Landmarks (no description: built, architect), and the National Register of Historic Places list (individual properties only; Chicago Landmarks among them merge into the City's rows). Left out: CPD Park Art (pxyq-qhyd), an inventory frozen in November 2016 that includes works since removed (the Columbus statues, July 2020), and the 2013 Parks - Public Art list (sj6t-9cju), its older copy; Landmark Districts are the map's heritage layer already. Interior murals are left out (not visible from the street).
